segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, distributes and services cranes and lifting equipment for customers across North and South America.
segments.evidence: The Americas reporting segment includes the North America and South America continents.

segments.name: Europe and Africa
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, rents and services tower and mobile cranes and aftermarket services for customers in Europe and Africa.
segments.evidence: The EURAF reporting segment includes the Europe and Africa continents, excluding the Middle East region.

segments.name: Middle East and Asia Pacific
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells cranes and lifting products for customers in Asia, Australia and the Middle East.
segments.evidence: The MEAP reporting segment includes the Asia and Australia continents and the Middle East region.

revenueModel.text: Manitowoc earns revenue from selling new and used cranes, rental fees, and aftermarket parts and services, primarily through a global network of independent distributors and rental companies, plus its own MGX Equipment Services distribution network.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily distribute our products through a global network of independent distributors and/or rental companies.
